goal: Decide whether to pilot a written decision handoff for small studios.

interview-a.excerpt: I lose the supplier decision every time somebody hands the project over.

interview-b.excerpt: A new project owner spent Monday reconstructing why we picked that vendor.

interview-c.excerpt: Our existing issue template already handles most handoffs.

studio-note.excerpt: We want to test demand before writing an integration.

candidates.action: Offer two studios a one-week decision handoff pilot.
candidates.experiment: Ask two operators to use a one-page handoff. Observe whether the next owner can recover the decision unaided.
Ask pilot participants where a second manual entry causes a missed handoff.
